name: U.S. Vaccination Timeline
title: When could everyone in the U.S. get vaccinated?
Topic: COVID-19 vaccination progress and herd-immunity projection
Data: CDC vaccination data and U.S. population totals
Game Goal: Estimate when herd immunity can be reached
Game Mechanics: Adjust daily vaccination doses and compare rollout speeds
Failure Trigger: Slow vaccination delays the projected completion time
Visualization Strategy: Timelines and progress projections show vaccination pace affecting herd-immunity timing

name: Birth Control Measures
title: Kan geboorte­beperking het wereld­wijde voedsel­probleem oplossen?
Topic: Global population growth and fertility control
Data: World population projections, regional fertility rates, and fertility-policy assumptions
Game Goal: Reduce future global population size
Game Mechanics: Adjust fertility rates or intervention intensity across regions
Failure Trigger: Persistently high fertility leads to excessive population growth
Visualization Strategy: Population projection curves and regional comparisons show long-term fertility-control effects

name: Who’s in the Crossword?
title: Who’s in the Crossword?
Data: Saul Pwanson’s crossword corpus, manual demographic labels, and U.S. Census categories
Game Goal: Complete the puzzle and experience uneven knowledge barriers
Game Mechanics: Use two sets of clues for the same answers
Failure Trigger: Lack of specific cultural knowledge prevents successful solving
Visualization Strategy: Crossword grids and demographic charts show representational bias in puzzle clues

name: Abortion Mazes
title: Abortion Mazes
Topic: Regional barriers to abortion access in the U.S.
Data: Guttmacher Institute state-level abortion-policy data and news-report-based personal stories
Game Goal: Navigate the maze to reach abortion care
Game Mechanics: Select a state or personal story and complete the corresponding maze
Failure Trigger: More restrictive policies make the maze harder to complete
Visualization Strategy: Policy restrictions mapped to maze complexity show abortion-access barriers

name: Inevitable Super Rich
title: Why the super rich are inevitable
Data: Yard-sale model simulations and redistribution parameters
Game Goal: Preserve or increase wealth through trading
Game Mechanics: Conduct coin-flip trades based on proportional stakes, with optional redistribution
Failure Trigger: Repeated random trades intensify wealth gaps
Visualization Strategy: Animated wealth distributions show concentration and compare redistribution scenarios

name: People of the Pandemic
title: People of the Pandemic
Data: U.S. ZIP-code population data, hospital data, and players’ weekly behavior choices
Game Goal: Slow transmission and avoid health-system collapse
Game Mechanics: Multiple players choose weekly outings while the system simulates spread
Failure Trigger: Excessive collective outings increase infections and exhaust hospital beds
Visualization Strategy: Community simulation and hospital-capacity feedback show collective-behavior consequences

name: The Wheel of Inequality
title: The Wheel of Inequality
Topic: Intergenerational inequality and social mobility in Spain
Data: Census data, economic indicators, and education records
Game Goal: Explore life chances under different social backgrounds
Game Mechanics: Select family background, education, and regional conditions
Failure Trigger: Background, school, and regional constraints limit upward mobility
Visualization Strategy: Wheel metaphor and life-path diagrams show how background shapes opportunity

name: 51 Sprints
title: 51 Sprints
Topic: Identity and fairness in Olympic sprinting
Data: Olympic 100-meter finals data, historical footage, and athlete identity variables
Game Goal: Help a selected athlete win gold
Game Mechanics: Select a race lineup and adjust identity-related variables with the Equaliser
Failure Trigger: The selected athlete fails to win
Visualization Strategy: Race-track simulation and rankings show identity factors affecting results

name: Educate Your Child
title: Educate Your Child
Data: Chicago school, income, race/ethnicity, school-zone, and housing-policy data
Game Goal: Choose a relatively suitable school for a child
Game Mechanics: Set family identity, residence conditions, and school choices
Failure Trigger: School quality, distance, and diversity cannot be jointly optimized
Visualization Strategy: School maps, scores, and choice paths show quality-distance-diversity trade-offs

name: The Nest Egg Game
title: The Nest Egg Game: Your Life in 10 Financial Milestones
Data: BLS, New York Fed, Census, NCES, FHFA, and related cost data
Game Goal: Keep the “nest egg” viable across life stages
Game Mechanics: Make financial decisions at multiple life milestones

Visualization Strategy: Life-stage cards and asset changes show debt, savings, and retirement risk

name: HeartSaver
title: HeartSaver

Data: CMS, New York State health data, NYC planning data, and Google Directions API data
Game Goal: Save as many cardiac patients as possible
Game Mechanics: Assign patients to different hospitals for treatment

Visualization Strategy: Urban maps, hospital ratings, and survival feedback show emergency-care allocation outcomes

name: The En-ROADS
title: The En-ROADS Climate Solutions Simulator En-ROADS

Game Goal: Keep global temperature rise at a lower level
Game Mechanics: Adjust energy mix, carbon pricing, technology investment, and land-use parameters
Failure Trigger: Insufficient policy combinations leave warming too high
Visualization Strategy: Temperature curves, emissions charts, and policy panels show mitigation-choice effects

name: The C-ROADS
title: The C-ROADS Climate Change Policy Simulator

Game Goal: Test whether pledges can meet climate goals

name: The Fiscal Ship
title: The Fiscal Ship

Game Goal: Stabilize federal debt under selected value priorities

name: Virus Growth
title: Virus Growth

Game Goal: Understand infection spread and intervention effects
Game Mechanics: Observe or adjust transmission processes and collect experimental data

name: Parable of the Polygons
title: Parable of the Polygons

name: Salubrious Guess

title: Tardware Tycoon

name: Federal Balancing Act
title: Federal Balancing Act

name: College Chances by Income

name: The Drug Overdose Epidemic
title: You Draw It: Just How Bad Is the Drug Overdose Epidemic?
Data: U.S. overdose-death statistics and local estimates

Game Mechanics: Draw a trend line and compare it with actual data
Failure Trigger: The scale or speed of the crisis is underestimated
